liebermann.description_de: British Museum, Cotton Vitellius A VII
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, British Library, Cotton MS Vitellius A.vii (Vt 2, the second pontifical)
liebermann.notes: Badly burnt. Vt (= Cv), the first pontifical, from Wessex c. 1060 (litany suggests shortly before 1000), most closely related to Rj and Ch, has the Sacramentum coronationis (f. 1, copied in Ju) and Iudicium Dei IX, I–III, VI, VII. Vt 2, a second pontifical of c. 1130, has Iudicium Dei XI–XIV, related to Mg and Tr.
